title: The Period an Enrolment's Reporting Record Is Read Over, Keyturn Host Protection Plan
content:
Before the reporting record of a Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment can be counted, the period it is read over has to be settled, and that period turns on how long the cover has stood and on whether a claim has been accepted on it.

The marketplace's settled-cover period is 24 months.

1. Where the enrolment has been in force for at least the marketplace's settled-cover period and no claim has been accepted on it in the twenty-four months before, the enrolment's reporting record is read over the twelve months before the report.
2. Where the enrolment has been in force for at least that period and a claim has been accepted on it in the twenty-four months before, the reporting record is read over the twenty-four months before the report.
3. Where the enrolment has been in force for less than that period, the reporting record is read over the whole life of the cover.

### Combinations

| Months the cover has stood | Claims accepted in the twenty-four months before | Period the record is read over |
|---|---|---|
| 24 or more | none | the twelve months before the report |
| 24 or more | one or more | the twenty-four months before the report |
| fewer than 24 | any | the whole life of the cover |

An enrolment that has stood for exactly 24 months has reached the settled-cover period; one that has stood 23 months has not, and its record is read over the whole life of the cover whatever its claim history.

### Records consulted

The months the cover has stood are counted from the day the cover became effective on the enrolment, and the claims counted are appraisals accepted on that enrolment within the twenty-four months before.
